fusions.name: Barbed Haul
fusions.desc: Hurls a barbed line at a target at or below 25% health, which deals 24 damage to the first enemy it meets.

fusions.name: Rip Through
fusions.desc: Drives a barb through armour: the strike deals 28 damage, ignores armour, and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Reel Them In
fusions.desc: Casts out a line of force 6 tiles long that lasts 4 seconds and drags every enemy near it inward.

fusions.name: Hooked Billhook
fusions.desc: Conjures a heavy billhook. Your weapon damage rises by 10%, and every strike with it makes the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.
